slides.title:
Mistakes that quietly steal
your focus in salah.
slides.sub: Most of mine were small. That's why I missed them.
slides.closer: Save this before your next prayer.

slides.title: Rushing through it.

diagram.js: const figs=[['dua','takbir'],['ruku','ruku\''],['person','stand'],['sujud','sujud'],['sit','sit']]; const n=figs.length; P.line(10,H*0.5+105,W-10,H*0.5+105,{c:'#ef6f9a',w:2.4,dash:[12,10]}); figs.forEach(([f,l],i)=>{const x=W*(0.09+0.82*i/(n-1)), y=H*0.5; P.fig(f,x,y,200,{c:'#f7f4ee',a:'#ef6f9a'}); P.text(x,y+150,l,{c:'#f7f4ee',size:29});}); P.text(W/2,H*0.12,'pause in every position',{c:'#ef6f9a',size:31});

slides.body: A man prayed fast, and the Prophet ﷺ told him three times: **"Go back and pray, for you have not prayed."**

slides.title: Letting your eyes wander.

diagram.js: const cx=W/2, cy=H*0.5; const L=[['door','the door',-0.95,-0.6],['walk','people',0.95,-0.6],['clock','a clock',-0.9,0.6],['phoneBuzz','your phone',0.92,0.6]]; L.forEach(([f,t,dx,dy])=>{const x=cx+dx*W*0.37, y=cy+dy*H*0.6; P.arrow(cx+Math.sign(dx)*95,cy+Math.sign(dy)*40,x-dx*90,y-dy*40,{c:T.muted,w:2.6,dash:[10,9]}); P.fig(f,x,y-30,115,{c:T.muted,a:'#c650c8'}); P.text(x,y+52,t,{c:T.muted,size:26});}); P.fig('mat',cx,cy,150,{c:'#f7f4ee',a:'#c650c8'}); P.text(cx,cy+100,'keep your eyes here',{c:'#c650c8',size:27});

slides.body: Looking around in prayer is **a theft Shaytan takes from your salah.** Keep your eyes where your forehead will go.

slides.title: Praying while starving.

diagram.caption: your mind is on the food

slides.body: No prayer when food is served, or while holding in the call of nature. **Eat or go first, then pray within its time.**

slides.title: Keeping your phone in sight.
slides.body: One buzz and your mind leaves the prayer. Silent mode isn't enough. **Put it out of sight.**

slides.title: Saying words you don't understand.
slides.body: You recite al-Fatihah at least 17 times a day. **Learn its meaning once, and every rak'ah changes.**

slides.title: Which ones steal your salah?

items.text: My eyes wander around the room
I pray hungry or holding it in
I don't know what al-Fatihah means

slides.closer: Pick one. Fix it at your next prayer.

slides.title:
Five prayers.
One fix at a time.
slides.sub: Follow for weekly tazkiyyah playbooks: small fixes for the heart, each with its source.

diagram.js: const CS=['#ef6f9a','#c650c8','#e5483b','#2451b8','#f4c430']; const a=[]; const yy=x=>H*0.6+Math.sin(x/W*Math.PI*2+0.6)*24; for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=24){a.push([x,yy(x)])} P.curve(a,{c:'#f7f4ee',w:5}); CS.forEach((c,i)=>{const x=W*0.12+i*W*0.14, y=yy(x)+4; P.blob(x,y,26,{fill:c}); P.text(x,y+1,String(i+1),{c:i==4?'#1d1d1f':'#fff',size:26,font:T.sans,weight:600});}); P.fig('walk',W*0.8,yy(W*0.8)-62,120,{c:'#f7f4ee'}); P.fig('mosque',W*0.93,yy(W*0.93)-70,140,{c:'#f7f4ee',a:'#f4c430'});
